changes.reason: HTML to PDF and image rendering use browser paragraph defaults: one em above and below each p element, including Document mode. Adjacent block margins still collapse into one gap. A bottom margin at the end of a page is dropped rather than opening an empty page when the content fits. HTML that relied on no paragraph top margin gains space above paragraphs; set p { margin-top: 0 } to keep the previous layout.

extraChanges.note: InternalsVisibleTo grants the existing browser engine and its tests access to detailed conversion and serialization evidence. This preserves browser diagnostics while keeping conversion kernels outside the public API.

extraChanges.old: HtmlToPdfOptions.FailOnLoss declared separately from the shared image/render options base
extraChanges.reason: Use the single loss control introduced in Core. The duplicate declaration hid the base property and failed the full staged module build; defaults, serialization shape and PDF loss rejection stay unchanged.

extraChanges.reason: Remove the fluent image surface while retaining format renderers, Core execution/persistence, streaming, deadlines, limits and diagnostic evidence.
